tests/Query.Native/Program.cs.readScope: Verify, final scenario-count/refusal/materializer checks, Main/Run and result publication (52-88,190-265); not every scenario construction body.

checks.basis: Artifact repository/run/commit/id, fixed byte size and archive SHA are checked; extracted complete package and native inventories are hash-checked on creation and reuse. ZIP traversal and symlinks are rejected. The GitHub API token is dropped before the separate HTTPS storage request.

checks.area: Same source and isolated PackageReference consumption
checks.basis: Output must be outside the product tree and phase directories cannot be overwritten. Consumer source hashes must equal the successful baseline. The copied project forbids Import/ProjectReference, uses the exact two provider PackageReferences, isolated cache and source mapping, then normal plus locked restore. Resolved NativeWeave archives must match the selected twelve-package feed.

Fresh processes execute JIT DLLs or published ELF executables. Native AOT is checked both by output shape and RuntimeFeature. Every loaded provider asset is hash-checked and /proc/self/maps must identify exactly that package file. Each process disposes its source/session and requires all six native owner counters to reach zero.

SQLite handover copies the exact old file after rejecting a nonempty WAL. PostgreSQL restores a hashed original custom dump into an isolated database. Independent Python SQLite/psql queries check explicit field values, NULL/empty text, decimal, UTC microseconds, bytes, relation rows, rolled-back IDs and SHA-384 migration history; success is not based only on old/new agreement.

checks.area: Complete finite matrix and DTO-only change
checks.basis: Fixed nested provider/runtime loops require fresh seed, historical observe and continue for every row. Exact semantic case-key sets and values are compared. Candidate DTO-v2 changes only ordinary C# source, must materialize the fourth projected field, preserve all original semantics and keep the native hash unchanged.

The same actual product SQLite ELF is passed to a separate ctypes process. Twenty-four fixed status/domain/code/output tuples are compared, including invalid-input precedence. Callback/retirement waits are bounded and all native owners must retire. An unexpected success or tuple difference raises and exits nonzero.

Query.Binding retains emitted golden-byte equality, compiled API/XML, native state/C-header checks, actual test/sample JIT/AOT and before/after input/native hashes. Query.Native locks both 26-case Rust oracle files to the merged Plan hashes, runs both providers through the actual combined test Host, and its C# Verify/Run rejects SQL/row/order/count failures before result publication. SQLite requires all fourteen native scenario families, actual Host asset/profile hashes, exact compiled API and executed JIT/AOT.

Child nonzero exit, timeout, missing file, oracle mismatch or input drift raises through wrappers. Migration writes passed=false on execution exceptions and only publishes comparison.json after all rows. Outer eng/build.py checks the clean source before/after the full run; database_regressions invokes every retained gate with no optional skip and emits a success result only at the end. Existing failure attempts are preserved.

Read the existing final-3 baseline/candidate/comparison JSON. Both source identities are clean 7ad56394; both phases and all four rows pass. All nine compared input identity fields and both JIT/AOT non-NativeWeave resolved archive maps are equal.

limitations: This is a source review and inspection of already produced receipts; no new native/managed test or benchmark was run.

The business matrix is finite. Its entity.columns field describes the declared typed schema rather than independently introspecting every provider metadata type; the separate original materialization/query gates remain necessary.

Race, disconnect, commit-outcome-unknown, bounded large streams, leak detection, package/runtime transfers and fresh-image build are covered by separate required suites, not established by this matrix.

The standalone migration driver records some helper/SDK identity fields without comparing all of them itself. The reviewed formal outer workflow enforces frozen clean source; the actual final-3 pair was additionally inspected here and those fields and resolved SDK package maps match.
Candidate-4 remote full CI is still in progress at this review. This review is not migration acceptance, merged-main evidence or external organizational approval.
conclusion: No blocking defect found within the stated complete consumer/verification-entrypoint scope. Keep the full original regression, sanitizer, packaging, fresh-image and merged-main CI acceptance gates mandatory.
